description: GENERAL PROPOSITIONAL DEDUCTION through the inference_generation collapse pipeline (DEDUCTION_GENERALIZATION_PREREG.md / DEDUCTION_GENERALIZATION_RESULTS.md). seeds/inference_knowledge.json already supplies 5 kinds of world-knowledge schema (knowledge_enabling/elaborative/partwhole/goal/causal) the gap-driven inference generator (domains/inference_generation.py) decodes gaps against, via the SAME ShapeDecode collapse reading_collapse.py uses for construction recognition. This seed adds a SIXTH kind, 'knowledge_logical': a HELD IMPLICATION (an antecedent held-predicate over an object => a consequent value) represented as graph data, mirroring the antecedent/consequent separation domains/ground_reductions.py's ImplicationClause/GroundedReduction ALREADY proves works for propositional deduction (real, executing modus ponens over group-theory theorems) -- reused here as the MODEL for the semantics, not the implementation (ground_reductions.py itself is untouched; its Python-callable antecedents are domain-bound to free-product structure and cannot read arbitrary graph facts). A knowledge_logical schema's `signature` is the antecedent fact pattern `[["holds", <antecedent_attr>]]` (the SAME structural-pattern-match discipline every other knowledge_* schema already uses, decoded via Covers, not executed as a callable); its `supplies` is the consequent, in the BYTE-IDENTICAL `{"relation": "is_a", "attr": ...}` shape knowledge_enabling schemas already use, so the mint reuses situation_model_reader.ingest_predication UNCHANGED (the exact call resolve_precondition_gap already makes). Node type stays ShapeSignature (per SHAPE_TYPE_VOCABULARY_SPIKE.md's corrected finding: node TYPE partitions a decode pool, kind is a label within it -- a new kind is an ADDITION to the existing pool, not a new mechanism). HONEST SCOPE (as of v1.0.0): single-antecedent-attribute implications only -- propositional modus-ponens-shaped inference, one antecedent fact => one consequent fact, exactly the class of theorem-implication ground_reductions.py already proves executable, generalized past group theory. The KNOWLEDGE below is finite and hand-seeded (the same discipline seeds/inference_knowledge.json's own description states for its 8 schemas: 'the KNOWLEDGE is finite and seeded; the MECHANISM is general'); domains/propositional_deduction.py additionally lets the agent MINT a schema of this same shape from ordinary conditional prose ('if X is a bird, X can fly') at runtime -- CORRECTED 2026-08-13 (see docs/research/engine_substrate/DEDUCTION_GENERAL_READER_CORRECTION_RESULTS.md) to ingest that prose through the GENERAL reading pipeline (reading_collapse.py's decompose_sentence/read_clause -- the SAME construction-decode machinery every other sentence in the corpus already uses) rather than a second, independent construction-grammar mini-parser, which the first landing of this seed's own description used to say and which duplicated a capability the general reader already had. comprehend_theorem.py stays untouched and group-theory-scoped, unrelated to this correction. v1.1.0 (LOGODDS_GENERATOR_RESULTS.md, CAUSAL_LINKAGE_DIMENSION_RESEARCH.md Sec7.2): adds a `causal_strength_ceiling` string attr on `logical_bird_can_fly` naming `latent:causal_strength` (the LatentDimension declared in seeds/inference_knowledge.json v1.1.0) -- a documentation-level cross-reference, NOT a graph edge (load_seed_manifest's local_id resolution is per-manifest-file, so a direct cross-file edge is not declarable without a name-based rule join this rung does not need). Read by nothing -- implies's own Covers-based structural matching (this file's entire decode mechanism) is completely UNCHANGED. Encodes CAUSAL_LINKAGE_DIMENSION_RESEARCH.md's own instruction precisely: knowledge_logical is the causal-strength dimension's CEILING quantum (the idealized limit of overwhelming confirming evidence with none disconfirming), not a value replaced by or merged into the graded dimension. v1.2.0 (DEDUCTION_EXTENSION_PREREG.md/_RESULTS.md): TWO extensions. (1) MODUS TOLLENS -- every knowledge_logical schema now gets a MECHANICALLY DERIVED contrapositive companion node at load time (domains/propositional_deduction.ensure_contrapositives, called from inference_generation.ensure_logical_seeds): P=>Q entails ~Q=>~P (classical logic, not a new interpretive schema), reusing the `not_`/`can_` name-prefix regularity the general reader's OWN complement-span joining already produces for a negated copular statement ('the ground is not wet' -> is_a(ground,not_wet), measured live). The contrapositive is NOT hand-authored in this file -- only `logical_bird_can_fly` and the two new forward schemas below are; `logical_bird_can_fly_contrapositive`/`logical_rain_wet_contrapositive`/`logical_wet_cold_frozen_contrapositive`(N/A, see below) come into being at ensure_logical_seeds load time. Once installed, inference_generation.py's EXISTING detect_implication_gaps/resolve_implication_gap/decode_gap run modus tollens with ZERO new gap-detection code (a stated not_wet==1 fact is already offered as a breadth candidate exactly like bird==1 is). local_id 3 (logical_rain_wet) is the literal 'if it rains then the ground is wet' example used for the live demo -- hand-seeded because its antecedent ('it rains') is an EVENT predication, outside parse_conditional's supported is_a-antecedent grammar (an honest, pre-existing parser-scope boundary, not something this v1.2.0 rung changes). (2) CONJUNCTIVE ANTECEDENTS -- local_id 4 (logical_wet_cold_frozen) is a hand-seeded TWO-antecedent schema (`signature: [["holds_all","wet"],["holds_all","cold"]]`) proving the SAME schema shape already generalizes to a multi-item signature with zero change (ShapeDecode's Covers matcher already jointly matches a multi-item goal against a multi-item signature -- measured live). Resolved by NEW inference_generation.py functions (detect_conjunctive_gaps/resolve_conjunctive_gap), which offer an entity's WHOLE stated-fact set as one joint candidate and gate on FULL signature coverage (Covers alone accepts PARTIAL coverage as a valid, lower-fit match -- measured live -- so the full-coverage check is genuinely new Python-side machinery, not a decode-side one). Uses the relation label `holds_all`, NOT `holds`: measured live that reusing `holds` would make the EXISTING, byte-unchanged detect_implication_gaps/resolve_implication_gap ALSO a candidate decoder for this schema (a genuine false-positive found and fixed while building this) -- `holds_all` is a NEW relation label matching this file's OWN existing per-gap-kind labelling convention (needs/needs_whole/needs_goal/physical_effect/elaborate/holds are already all distinct). Conjunctive antecedents are NOT auto-derived a contrapositive (the contrapositive of a conjunction is a disjunction, a representational form this arc does not support -- derive_contrapositive's own signature-length guard skips it, an honest no-op). Conjunctive PROSE PARSING (an 'if X is P and X is Q, X is R' sentence parsed live, the way logical_rain_wet's sibling schemas are prose-minted elsewhere) was investigated and NOT built -- decompose_sentence's own clause tokeniser drops the 'and' coordinator during glue-word filtering, leaving no marker in ITS OWN output to split on; building a raw-string splitter outside that mechanism would risk exactly the 'second grammar duplicating a capability the general reader doesn't have' anti-pattern DEDUCTION_GENERAL_READER_CORRECTION_RESULTS.md corrected the SAME DAY -- named as a follow-on, not attempted. Quantifiers (universal/existential instantiation) were investigated as a stretch goal and NOT attempted -- see DEDUCTION_EXTENSION_RESULTS.md Sec4 for the precise finding (Exists/Binding machinery already exists in the Term algebra and the deduction module is already IMPLICITLY universally quantified over resident entities; an EXPLICIT quantifier-scoped premise representation does not exist and was not built).

attrs.name: inference_logical
attrs.description: The sentinel concept guarding idempotent load of this seed (domains.propositional_deduction.ensure_logical_seeds).

attrs.name: logical_bird_can_fly
attrs.statement: if X is a bird, X can fly
attrs.chain: PARSE 'if X is a bird, X can fly' -> ANTECEDENT is_a(X,bird) => CONSEQUENT is_a(X,can_fly) [propositional, held, hand-seeded]
attrs.causal_strength_ceiling_note: LOGODDS_GENERATOR_RESULTS.md / CAUSAL_LINKAGE_DIMENSION_RESEARCH.md Sec7.2: knowledge_logical is this dimension's CEILING quantum, not a separate primitive and not replaced -- a proof-grade Covers-matched implication is causal-strength evidence at its idealized limit (confirm evidence dominating completely, disconfirm absent), the same degenerate-to-boolean limit Cheng's own causal-power theory has at its idealized center. This is a plain string cross-reference to the LatentDimension node declared in seeds/inference_knowledge.json (local_id 14), NOT a graph edge -- load_seed_manifest's local_id resolution is scoped per manifest file (runners/dsl/src/py.rs resolve_seed_ref), so a cross-file edge is not directly declarable without a name-based rule join this rung does not need. implies's own Covers-based structural matching is completely UNCHANGED by this attribute -- it is documentation-level graph data, read by nothing in domains/propositional_deduction.py or domains/inference_generation.py (confirmed by grep, LOGODDS_GENERATOR_RESULTS.md Sec5).

attrs.name: logical_rain_wet
attrs.statement: if it rains then the ground is wet
attrs.chain: HAND-SEEDED (v1.2.0, DEDUCTION_EXTENSION_PREREG.md Sec2): the literal MODUS TOLLENS demo example -> ANTECEDENT is_a(X,rain) => CONSEQUENT is_a(X,wet) [propositional, held]. Hand-seeded rather than prose-minted: the antecedent 'it rains' is an EVENT predication (rain is a verb, not a copular is_a complement), outside domains/propositional_deduction.parse_conditional's supported single-antecedent is_a-shape grammar -- an honest, pre-existing parser-scope boundary (DEDUCTION_GENERAL_READER_CORRECTION_RESULTS.md), not something this rung changes. Its contrapositive companion (logical_rain_wet_contrapositive: is_a(X,not_wet) => is_a(X,not_rain)) is MECHANICALLY DERIVED at ensure_logical_seeds load time (domains/propositional_deduction.ensure_contrapositives), not hand-authored here.

attrs.name: logical_wet_cold_frozen
attrs.statement: if X is wet and X is cold, X is frozen
attrs.chain: HAND-SEEDED (v1.2.0, DEDUCTION_EXTENSION_PREREG.md Sec3): the CONJUNCTIVE ANTECEDENT demo example -> ANTECEDENT is_a(X,wet) AND is_a(X,cold) => CONSEQUENT is_a(X,frozen) [propositional, held, TWO-conjunct]. The SAME knowledge_logical kind/node type as every other schema in this pool -- `signature`'s LENGTH differs (2 items, not 1), proving the schema shape already generalizes with zero engine change. Uses the relation label `holds_all`, NOT `holds`: measured live that reusing `holds` would make the EXISTING, byte-unchanged detect_implication_gaps/resolve_implication_gap ALSO a candidate decoder for this schema (ShapeDecode's Covers matcher accepts PARTIAL coverage as a valid match, so MP's own one-attr-at-a-time goal would misfire `frozen` from `wet` ALONE) -- `holds_all` is a NEW relation label matching this file's OWN existing per-gap-kind labelling convention (needs/needs_whole/needs_goal/physical_effect/elaborate/holds are already all distinct), keeping this schema invisible to the `holds`-only MP/MT pipeline by construction. Resolved by inference_generation.detect_conjunctive_gaps/resolve_conjunctive_gap (new functions), which require BOTH conjuncts to be jointly stated before minting (a full-coverage gate ON TOP of ShapeDecode's own Covers match, which alone accepts partial coverage -- measured live, see DEDUCTION_EXTENSION_RESULTS.md Sec3). Hand-seeded, not prose-minted: conjunctive-antecedent prose parsing was investigated and named as a follow-on, not built (see this file's top-level description v1.2.0 note). NOT given a contrapositive companion: derive_contrapositive's own signature-length guard skips any schema whose signature is not length-1 (the contrapositive of a conjunction is a disjunction, a representational form this arc does not support) -- an honest no-op, not a silent wrong answer.
